integrity: Analytic proof supplies global uniqueness and parameter monotonicity. Finite-arithmetic program CHECK.py supplies independent formula diagnostics, not an infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only on complex degree-at-most-two analytic polynomials, for real sign multipliers and power-weighted disk fourth norms. No higher-degree, unrestricted Bergman-space, or arbitrary-phase multiplier constant is asserted. Historical priority remains best-knowledge; complete text of the 2021 motivating article and two related repository results was unavailable.
title: Sharp sign distortion on weighted Bergman quadratics and its Gaussian limit
